 3 3/8" x 5 7/8": folds out to 13 1/4" x 8 7/8". Switzerland: Paillard Ltd. (1950). 
 The later model L8 was made and sold until 1953 when it was replaced by the B8 as Paillard's pocket size camera. This promotional brochure from 1950 details the L8 camera, its accessories and 8mm Kern lenses.
